text:
maria_sales: Quick warm transfer for HalcyonPay — closed ARR $420k, enterprise. Contract signed today, 12-month with 3-month pilot (opt-in for Dedicated after pilot). Main asks: SSO (Okta), EU data residency, monthly latency SLO <200ms for inference. 

ashwin_csm: Thanks Maria. I'm taking primary CSM ownership. Can someone paste the signed scope and the pilot success metrics? Also confirm expected go-live date for pilot.

maria_sales: Scopes: hosted API for pilot, audit logs retention 12 months, private deploy option evaluated for Q3. Pilot success = 5k monthly active end users, median 95th pct latency <220ms, <2% regressed responses (quality). Go-live pilot target: 2025-04-07.

ryan_se: Noted. SE input: HalcyonPay uses long-context dialogs (~3k tokens) and multi-step reranking. Recommend quantized LLM variant rdx-13b-q4 for cost/latency tradeoff. Will test end-to-end in sandbox. Need API sample traffic and representative prompts.

claire_onboard: I'll own onboarding checklist + training. I'll set up two enablement sessions: developer sandbox (API keys & SDKs) and product training for PMs. Suggest dates week of 2025-03-31. Who's owning credentials rotation?

jordan_support: Support lead here. Add me to escalation path. We'll need SLOs in Ops playbook and a point of contact for incidents. Also confirm whether Dedicated capacity will be requested during pilot (likely not).

neha_pm: Product feedback captured during sales cycles: customer flagged model hallucination on billing language and wants stronger reranker affordances. We'll add a short eval prompt set to the ticket and track baseline.

maria_sales: Owner summary: CSM = @ashwin_csm, SE = @ryan_se (sandbox tests), Onboarding = @claire_onboard, Support = @jordan_support, Product feedback = @neha_pm. Legal/compliance pending: data residency clause countersign; legalowner@halcyonpay.

ashwin_csm: Next steps I have: 1) Claire to schedule enablement invites by 2025-03-20. 2) Ryan to run sandbox perf/quality tests and post results in this thread by 2025-03-25. 3) Neha to create eval prompt set in /docs/halcyonpay-evals and link here. 4) Jordan to draft incident runbook and sharing permissions for audit logs.

ryan_se: I'll start perf tests tonight. Posting quick curl for their engineers to sample payloads:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <sandbox-key>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rdx-13b-q4","input":"<representative dialog>","max_tokens":256}'
```

claire_onboard: Sending calendar invites now. Also prepping a short "getting started" runbook with SDK snippets and SSO checklist. Will confirm Okta metadata request by EOD. :thumbsup:

jordan_support: Shared escalation path: PagerDuty on-call (Support L1 -> L2 -> SE -> Eng oncall). I've added @infra-bot to the channel for deployment alerts.

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline for halcyonpay-sandbox created: build-6789 queued. CI will post results here.

neha_pm: Added initial eval set to /docs/halcyonpay-evals and linked: https://confluence/redwood/halcyonpay-evals. Baseline quality metrics: reranker-0.72 NDCG, hallucination rate ~3.8% (sample).

ashwin_csm: Great — I'll compile a single onboarding ticket with these owners and dates and assign. Any immediate renewal risk? Maria: contract length 12 months so low risk now, but watch model quality.

maria_sales: Low renewal risk at close. Potential risk if QA/regulatory slows private deployment or if latency remains >250ms at scale. All noted. Thanks team — please update this thread when tasks complete.
